description: Pins the exact claude-swap (Python core) revision that this macOS app bundles as a helper process. Edit only via scripts/update-core.sh — do not hand-edit commitSha/tag together, they must refer to the same revision.

helper.note: binaryName/bundleLocation MUST match ClaudeSwap/CoreBridge/BridgeProcess.swift's HelperLocator, which resolves the bundled helper via Bundle.main.url(forAuxiliaryExecutable: "claude-swap-helper") — i.e. a single executable at Contents/MacOS/, not a per-architecture path under Resources/. See docs/PACKAGING.md for how package-release.sh keeps app+helper architecture-consistent. entryPointCandidates: build-core-helper.sh uses the first entry point module that exists in the pinned core checkout; claude_swap.bridge (contracts/**) is preferred once present, claude_swap.cli:main is the fallback.

localOverride.note: Absolute path to a sibling checkout of claude-swap used instead of fetching repository@tag/commitSha during local development. If this path does not exist on the current machine, scripts fall back to '<parent-of-repo-root>/claude-swap' (i.e. a sibling of this checkout) before giving up and requiring a real pin. Set enabled=false for CI/release builds so the pinned commitSha is used instead.
